verdict.rationale: Ashby publishes a per-endpoint API reference at developers.ashbyhq.com/reference, covering pagination, application.list with a sync token, and candidate.create. Its markdown/llms.txt versions return HTTP 200, which helps AI-native consumption. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the probed OpenAPI spec paths all return 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
